params.prompt:
Create a polished ORIGINAL CREATURE CONCEPT ATLAS for Riptide, a hand-painted fantasy chibi RPG. This is a visual breeding catalogue: every requested cell is ONE NEW hybrid creature, visibly inheriting anatomical traits from BOTH named parents. Reference images show the existing parent species and exact visual style; use their painted shapes and palette, never copy the reference atlas layout.
EXACT OUTPUT LAYOUT: landscape 3:2 image, an INVISIBLE uniform grid of FIVE equal columns by THREE equal rows. EXACTLY FIFTEEN separate complete creatures. Read the assignments in row-major order: row1 left-to-right cells01-05, row2 cells06-10, row3 cells11-15. Each creature occupies only its own cell and stays centered with at least 20 percent transparent clearance on EVERY side. Entire tails, horns, antlers, paws and wings must fit within that cell. No extras, no empty cells, no overlap. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA BACKGROUND outside the silhouettes. No scene, no terrain, no white matte, no checkerboard, no visible grid, NO LETTERING or labels or numbers. Labels will be added by code.
STYLE: match the supplied original Riptide Tides: beautiful hand-painted storybook fantasy sprites, bold clean dark-brown ink outlines, warm modeled painterly highlights, detailed fur/feathers/scales, large expressive heads, short sturdy chibi proportions, powerful readable silhouettes, cool mutated fantasy animals. A range of charming to fierce, no gore. Full-body three-quarter SIDE VIEW, head facing RIGHT, tail left; anatomically connected single head/body, grounded feet or a clearly intentional floating pose. Restrained magical body highlights, no huge glow clouds or floor shadows. Six-limbed fantasy creatures only where a specified wing pair or insect anatomy needs it. Balanced inheritance, not an original animal simply recolored.

STRICT PLACEMENT: Creature centers are at x=10%,30%,50%,70%,90% of the image and y=16.67%,50%,83.33%. Each creature including every appendage fits within just 60% of its own cell width and 70% of its own cell height. Transparent gutters between every pair of neighbors are essential. Do not enlarge a creature to fill its entire cell. Match these fifteen independent center points precisely.
